{"code": "import heapq, collections

def solve_sokoban():
    grid_str = """+ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
+ + $ + + + + + + - + + + + + + - - +
+ $ + + $ + + + + - - - - - - - - - +
+ + + + + + - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + + + + + - - - - + - - - - - - - +
+ + + + + - - - + + + - - - - - - - +
+ + + + + - - + + + + + - - - - - - +
+ + + + + + + + + + + $ - - - - - - +
+ + + + + + + - - + + - - - - - - - +
+ + + + + + - - - - + + - @ - - - - +
+ + + + - - @ X - - - - - - - - X - +
+ + + + - - - - - - - - - - - X - - +
+ + + - - - - - - X * - - @ - - - - +
+ + + - - - - - - - - X - - @ - - - +
+ + - - - - - - - - - - - - - @ - - +
+ + - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + - - - @ - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + + + - - X + - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +"""
    lines = [l.split() for l in grid_str.strip().split('\n')]
    walls = set()
    goals = set()
    boxes = set()
    player = None
    for r, row in enumerate(lines):
        for c, char in enumerate(row):
            if char == '+': walls.add((r, c))
            elif char == 'X': goals.add((r, c))
            elif char == '@': boxes.add((r, c))
            elif char == '*': player = (r, c)
            elif char == '$': 
                boxes.add((r, c))
                goals.add((r, c))

    def is_deadlock(box, boxes, goals, walls):
        if box in goals: return False
        r, c = box
        # Simple corner deadlock
        for dr, dc in [(-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)]:
            if (r+dr, c) in walls and (r, c+dc) in walls: return True
        return False

    # Use A* with a state limit and better priority
    start_boxes = tuple(sorted(list(boxes)))
    start_state = (player, start_boxes)
    
    # Heuristic: sum of min distances box -> goal
    def get_h(boxes_tuple):
        h = 0
        for b in boxes_tuple:
            if b not in goals:
                h += min(abs(b[0]-g[0]) + abs(b[1]-g[1]) for g in goals)
        return h

    queue = [(get_h(start_boxes), 0, player, start_boxes, "")]
    visited = {(player, start_boxes): 0}
    
    while queue:
        _, dist, p, b, path = heapq.heappop(queue)
        if set(b) == goals: return path
        if dist > 100: continue # Limit depth
        
        for dr, dc, m in [(-1,0,'U'), (1,0,'D'), (0,-1,'L'), (0,1,'R')]:
            np = (p[0]+dr, p[1]+dc)
            if np in walls: continue
            
            if np in b:
                nb = (np[0]+dr, np[1]+dc)
                if nb in walls or nb in b: continue
                if is_deadlock(nb, b, goals, walls): continue
                
                new_b = tuple(sorted(list(set(b) - {np} | {nb})))
                new_state = (np, new_b)
                if new_state not in visited or visited[new_state] > dist + 1:
                    visited[new_state] = dist + 1
                    heapq.heappush(queue, (dist + 1 + get_h(new_b), dist + 1, np, new_b, path + m))
            else:
                new_state = (np, b)
                if new_state not in visited or visited[new_state] > dist + 1:
                    visited[new_state] = dist + 1
                    heapq.heappush(queue, (dist + 1 + get_h(b), dist + 1, np, b, path + m))

    return "No solution"

print(solve_sokoban())"}
